concreteBug: public_deploy_enabled catches every API error and converts it into operator-disabled. The workflow does not pass its vars value, so landing rereads the variables REST endpoint with the workflow token.

offlineCounterexample.result: read failure indistinguishable from disabled flag

inference: Workflow-token Variables permission mismatch is likely cause: endpoint requires Variables repository read; configured token permissions have no Variables. Underlying actual API status was swallowed and is not recoverable from retained logs. Do not claim an observedHTTP403.
smallestFix: Pass vars.CLOUDFLARE_PUBLIC_DEPLOY_ENABLED explicitly to landing step; use that declared value and retain its decision source. Distinguish omitted/false from API read errors; do not enlarge token permissions or silently relabel operational failures.
